# Glossary

Current Zerospin vocabulary at `HEAD`.

| Term                           | Meaning                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | Source                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| System                         | The authored `makeSystem` graph: name/version, universal authentication, aggregates, services, frontend bindings, and owner authorization.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | ([`types.ts:249-269`](../packages/core/src/system/types.ts#L249-L269), [`makeSystem.ts:460-551`](../packages/core/src/system/makeSystem.ts#L460-L551))                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `Repo`                         | A keyed authority over durable state, ordering, invariants, and lifecycle transitions. It does not imply Durable Object inheritance or use of a particular database factory.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | [`types.ts:51-68`](../packages/core/src/system/types.ts#L51-L68), [`AggregateRepo.ts:176-238`](../packages/system-worker/src/AggregateRepo/AggregateRepo.ts#L176-L238), [`SystemRepo.ts:355-360`](../packages/system-worker/src/SystemRepo/SystemRepo.ts#L355-L360)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `BoundDORepo`                  | A Repo implemented as a path-named Durable Object whose base schema and optional bootstrap are provisioned once behind persisted `_isBootstrapped`; optional registration runs outside that one-time branch.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | [`makeBoundDORepo.ts:28-210`](../packages/system-worker/src/makeBoundDORepo/makeBoundDORepo.ts#L28-L210)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| authentication signature       | A stable-SemVer current schema plus retained historical schemas and direct adapters to current.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | ([`makeSignature.ts:4-31`](../packages/core/src/authentication/makeSignature.ts#L4-L31), [`makeSignature.ts:38-75`](../packages/core/src/authentication/makeSignature.ts#L38-L75))                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| authentication lock            | The selected signature version and exact JSON Schema submitted to universal authentication.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | ([`makeAuthenticationLock.ts:6-33`](../packages/core/src/authentication/makeAuthenticationLock.ts#L6-L33))                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `userId`                       | The non-empty string returned by the System authenticator. It is the only user identity authenticated at the root boundary.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | [`authenticate.ts:57-73`](../packages/system-worker/src/authenticate/authenticate.ts#L57-L73)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `GatewayApi`                   | Stable Worker-hosted root. It exposes environment-specific deploy children, exchanges a secret key for `SystemApi`, and authenticates a publishable-key caller into an active-generation `AuthenticatedApi`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | [`GatewayApi.ts:23-98`](../packages/system-worker/src/GatewayApi/GatewayApi.ts#L23-L98)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `AuthenticatedApi`             | A remote capability whose private resolver/authentication tuple is exactly `{ authenticationLock, generationId, systemId, systemName, systemVersion, systemWorkerName, userId }`; it independently authorizes aggregate/service child capabilities.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | [`AuthenticatedApi.ts:21-54`](../packages/system-worker/src/AuthenticatedApi/AuthenticatedApi.ts#L21-L54), [`AuthenticatedApi.ts:56-104`](../packages/system-worker/src/AuthenticatedApi/AuthenticatedApi.ts#L56-L104)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| aggregate authorization target | Exact `{ aggregateName, aggregateId, userId, frontendName }`. The caller-selected controller supplies `aggregateName` and `frontendName`, Provider supplies `aggregateId`, and authentication supplies `userId`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | [`authorizeAggregateFrontend.ts:11-17`](../packages/system-worker/src/AggregateRepo/authorizeAggregateFrontend/authorizeAggregateFrontend.ts#L11-L17), [`makeZerospinApp.tsx:392-447`](../packages/react/src/makeZerospinApp.tsx#L392-L447)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| service authorization target   | Exact `{ serviceName, userId, frontendName }`. The caller-selected controller supplies `serviceName` and `frontendName`, and authentication supplies `userId`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | [`authorizeServiceFrontend.ts:9-14`](../packages/system-worker/src/ServiceRepo/authorizeServiceFrontend/authorizeServiceFrontend.ts#L9-L14), [`makeZerospinApp.tsx:360-378`](../packages/react/src/makeZerospinApp.tsx#L360-L378)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `IUserRef`                     | Aggregate actor reference `{ aggregateName, aggregateId, userId }`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | ([`types.ts:23-27`](../packages/core/src/aggregate/types.ts#L23-L27))                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| frontend controller            | Source-imported aggregate/service representation definition. It contains target names, models, aggregate contracts/guards, and no authentication fields.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | ([`types.ts:17-66`](../packages/core/src/frontendController/types.ts#L17-L66))                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| source selection               | Sparse root configuration that selects current or retained model/contract definitions from a frontend controller.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | ([`resolveFrontendSourceSelection.ts:112-126`](../packages/react/src/resolveFrontendSourceSelection.ts#L112-L126), [`resolveFrontendSourceSelection.ts:209-347`](../packages/react/src/resolveFrontendSourceSelection.ts#L209-L347))                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| frontend lock                  | Complete representation identity. Aggregate locks contain `{ systemName, frontendName, models, contracts }`; service locks contain `{ systemName, frontendName, models }`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | ([`makeAggregateFrontendLock.ts:6-33`](../packages/core/src/frontendController/makeAggregateFrontendLock.ts#L6-L33), [`makeServiceFrontendLock.ts:6-25`](../packages/core/src/frontendController/makeServiceFrontendLock.ts#L6-L25))                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| frontend lock key              | Deterministic hash used to address one exact frontend representation materialization. Structural lock validation remains authoritative.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | ([`makeAggregateFrontendLockKey.ts:6-49`](../packages/core/src/frontendController/makeAggregateFrontendLockKey.ts#L6-L49), [`makeServiceFrontendLockKey.ts:6-49`](../packages/core/src/frontendController/makeServiceFrontendLockKey.ts#L6-L49))                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `AggregateFrontendApi`         | Independently disposable aggregate capability. `getAdmission()` replays its exact flat admitted identity/lock/spec receipt; state, queries, and ticket use the bound generation, while complete-command push carries no deploy identity and enters singleton `SystemRepo`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | [`AggregateFrontendApi.ts:29-134`](../packages/system-worker/src/AggregateFrontendApi/AggregateFrontendApi.ts#L29-L134), [`pushCommands.ts:52-61`](../packages/system-worker/src/AggregateFrontendApi/pushCommands/pushCommands.ts#L52-L61)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `ServiceFrontendApi`           | Independently disposable read-only service capability. `getAdmission()` replays its exact flat admitted identity/lock/spec receipt; state and ticket work use its bound generation.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | [`ServiceFrontendApi.ts:17-100`](../packages/system-worker/src/ServiceFrontendApi/ServiceFrontendApi.ts#L17-L100)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Provider lifecycle             | One scoped `ZerospinApp.Provider` Effect whose props provide `generateSignature` and `aggregateIds`, not `userId` or a page-owned `AuthenticatedApi`. It opens an identity-neutral SharedWorker port, consumes the worker-returned `{ systemId, userId, mode }`, acquires every configured session, publishes their map atomically, and owns release.                                                                                                                                                                        | [`makeZerospinApp.tsx:144-166`](../packages/react/src/makeZerospinApp.tsx#L144-L166), [`makeZerospinApp.tsx:206-242`](../packages/react/src/makeZerospinApp.tsx#L206-L242), [`makeZerospinApp.tsx:269-459`](../packages/react/src/makeZerospinApp.tsx#L269-L459)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `UserPartitionRepo`            | Port-bound `{ systemId, userId }` SharedWorker capability for exact aggregate/service Repo acquisition, aggregate handoff, exact-lock push controls, and diagnostics.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | [`getUserPartitionRepo.ts:497-634`](../packages/shared-worker/src/SharedWorker/SharedWorkerApi/getUserPartitionRepo/getUserPartitionRepo.ts#L497-L634), [`UserPartitionRepo.ts:30-192`](../packages/shared-worker/src/SharedWorker/UserPartitionRepo/UserPartitionRepo.ts#L30-L192)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| browser user locator           | Native IndexedDB configuration locator `zerospin/056/last-user-partition-store`. Its key is the JSON encoding of `{ apiUrl, publishableKey, systemName, authenticationLock }`; its strict record is `{ key, systemId, userId }`. The SharedWorker reads it only after an allowed initial authentication failure and writes the online identity before publishing the user root.                                                                                                                                              | [`lastUserPartitionStore.ts:7-15`](../packages/shared-worker/src/SharedWorker/lastUserPartitionStore.ts#L7-L15), [`getUserPartitionRepo.ts:381-469`](../packages/shared-worker/src/SharedWorker/SharedWorkerApi/getUserPartitionRepo/getUserPartitionRepo.ts#L381-L469), [`getUserPartitionRepo.ts:592-634`](../packages/shared-worker/src/SharedWorker/SharedWorkerApi/getUserPartitionRepo/getUserPartitionRepo.ts#L592-L634), [`lastUserPartitionStore.ts:306-411`](../packages/shared-worker/src/SharedWorker/lastUserPartitionStore.ts#L306-L411)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| handoff                        | One-attempt boundary from a synchronously committed main-thread aggregate session to the exact `AggregateFrontendReplicaRepo`; only a handoff committed there is resumable.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | [`makeSession.ts:337-480`](../packages/core/src/session/makeSession.ts#L337-L480), [`stageAggregateFrontendCommand.ts:43-108`](../packages/shared-worker/src/SharedWorker/UserPartitionRepo/stageAggregateFrontendCommand/stageAggregateFrontendCommand.ts#L43-L108)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| push                           | `AggregateFrontendReplicaRepo` admission/reconciliation for exact `{ systemId, userId, aggregateName, aggregateId, frontendName, aggregateFrontendLockKey }`, using its sticky Repo-owned inline `{ registrationId, ownerToken, authenticatedApi, frontendApi }`; when selection is required, it scans usable online registrations in allocation order.                                                                                                                                                                      | [`AggregateFrontendReplicaRepo.ts:198-243`](../packages/shared-worker/src/SharedWorker/AggregateFrontendReplicaRepo/AggregateFrontendReplicaRepo.ts#L198-L243), [`AggregateFrontendReplicaRepo.ts:1560-1800`](../packages/shared-worker/src/SharedWorker/AggregateFrontendReplicaRepo/AggregateFrontendReplicaRepo.ts#L1560-L1800)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| fan-out                        | Post-commit SharedWorker delivery of an exact-lock replica block or state replacement to each live registration for that Repo.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | [`AggregateFrontendReplicaRepo.ts:1245-1316`](../packages/shared-worker/src/SharedWorker/AggregateFrontendReplicaRepo/AggregateFrontendReplicaRepo.ts#L1245-L1316)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| convergence                    | Combined exact-lock push, server execution, authoritative block delivery, replay, and fan-out that settles local optimism to canonical state.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | [`AggregateFrontendReplicaRepo.ts:1700-2112`](../packages/shared-worker/src/SharedWorker/AggregateFrontendReplicaRepo/AggregateFrontendReplicaRepo.ts#L1700-L2112)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `sessionIndex`                 | Positive per-main-thread-session order for successful local commits, paired with the complete command's `sessionId`; it may have worker-side gaps after a failed one-attempt handoff.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | [`makeSession.ts:286-334`](../packages/core/src/session/makeSession.ts#L286-L334), [`AggregateFrontendReplicaRepo.ts:115-171`](../packages/shared-worker/src/SharedWorker/AggregateFrontendReplicaRepo/AggregateFrontendReplicaRepo.ts#L115-L171)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `replicaIndex`                 | Transaction order owned by one exact aggregate or service frontend Repo and persisted with its state.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | [`AggregateFrontendReplicaRepo.ts:2624-2823`](../packages/shared-worker/src/SharedWorker/AggregateFrontendReplicaRepo/AggregateFrontendReplicaRepo.ts#L2624-L2823)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `frontendIndex`                | Server-owned monotonic order of canonical AggregateFrontendRepo projection blocks; it is independent of session, SharedWorker `UserPartitionRepo`, and exact-lock materialization order.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | [`AggregateFrontendRepo.ts:258-269`](../packages/system-worker/src/AggregateFrontendRepo/AggregateFrontendRepo.ts#L258-L269), [`handleAggregateBlocks.ts:60-208`](../packages/system-worker/src/AggregateFrontendRepo/handleAggregateBlocks/handleAggregateBlocks.ts#L60-L208)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| user partition root            | Persistent browser catalog `{ systemId, userId }` in `replicas.db` under the VFS prefix `zerospin/056/${systemId}/users/${userId}`. Its current baseline contains only `aggregateFrontendReplicas` and `serviceFrontendReplicas`, with no mutable replica state or command journal.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | [`makeVfsName.ts:3-10`](../packages/shared-worker/src/SharedWorker/makeVfsName.ts#L3-L10), [`getUserPartitionRepo.ts:517-566`](../packages/shared-worker/src/SharedWorker/SharedWorkerApi/getUserPartitionRepo/getUserPartitionRepo.ts#L517-L566), [`userReplicaSchemas.ts:176-247`](../packages/shared-worker/src/SharedWorker/userReplicaSchemas.ts#L176-L247)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `AggregateFrontendReplicaRepo` | SharedWorker mutable state, journal, push, aggregate WebSocket, repair, and fan-out owner keyed by exact `{ systemId, userId, aggregateName, aggregateId, frontendName, aggregateFrontendLockKey }`, with one physical database and one sticky inline `{ registrationId, ownerToken, authenticatedApi, frontendApi }`. Selection and socket callbacks recheck the exact socket, registration, owner, selection attempt, and current-root `AuthenticatedApi`; an exact lock/admission denial terminally fails only this Repo. | [`AggregateFrontendReplicaRepo.ts:198-243`](../packages/shared-worker/src/SharedWorker/AggregateFrontendReplicaRepo/AggregateFrontendReplicaRepo.ts#L198-L243), [`AggregateFrontendReplicaRepo.ts:1560-1822`](../packages/shared-worker/src/SharedWorker/AggregateFrontendReplicaRepo/AggregateFrontendReplicaRepo.ts#L1560-L1822), [`AggregateFrontendReplicaRepo.ts:1992-2025`](../packages/shared-worker/src/SharedWorker/AggregateFrontendReplicaRepo/AggregateFrontendReplicaRepo.ts#L1992-L2025), [`AggregateFrontendReplicaRepo.ts:2082-2407`](../packages/shared-worker/src/SharedWorker/AggregateFrontendReplicaRepo/AggregateFrontendReplicaRepo.ts#L2082-L2407)                                                                                                                                                              |
| `ServiceFrontendReplicaRepo`   | Read-only SharedWorker mutable state, service WebSocket, repair, and fan-out owner keyed by exact `{ systemId, userId, serviceName, frontendName, serviceFrontendLockKey }`, with one physical journal-free database and one sticky inline `{ registrationId, ownerToken, authenticatedApi, frontendApi }`. Selection and socket callbacks recheck the exact socket, registration, owner, selection attempt, and current-root `AuthenticatedApi`; an exact lock/admission denial terminally fails only this Repo.            | [`ServiceFrontendReplicaRepo.ts:97-133`](../packages/shared-worker/src/SharedWorker/ServiceFrontendReplicaRepo/ServiceFrontendReplicaRepo.ts#L97-L133), [`ServiceFrontendReplicaRepo.ts:579-855`](../packages/shared-worker/src/SharedWorker/ServiceFrontendReplicaRepo/ServiceFrontendReplicaRepo.ts#L579-L855), [`ServiceFrontendReplicaRepo.ts:1043-1077`](../packages/shared-worker/src/SharedWorker/ServiceFrontendReplicaRepo/ServiceFrontendReplicaRepo.ts#L1043-L1077), [`ServiceFrontendReplicaRepo.ts:1150-1455`](../packages/shared-worker/src/SharedWorker/ServiceFrontendReplicaRepo/ServiceFrontendReplicaRepo.ts#L1150-L1455)                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| existing-only                  | Worker-side offline acquisition mode entered only when the initial root authentication attempt fails with `user-authentication-transport-failed`, `gateway-infrastructure-failure`, `system-deploy-activating`, `system-deploy-failed`, or `system-not-ready`. It opens only existing VFS/database state, validates an exact ready cached replica, and performs no child admission, state, ticket, repair, or push work.
